title: SimPO margin states
description: A horizontal interval band divides the policy margin into preference reversed, correct but below target, and target satisfied states at boundaries zero and 0.5.
source_artifact: SimPO state definition used in the evaluation

layout_geometry.region_widths: Conceptual; the R and T intervals are unbounded and are shown with open arrow ends.

direction: Higher policy margin moves from left to right.
caveat: Region widths are conceptual and do not encode the size or frequency of each state.
